=== Usage ===

===Technical note===
Used subtemplates: {{tl|IPA vowels audio/vowelpair}}
Input options:
<pre>{{IPA vowels audio/vowelpair
|
|
|
|
| soundfile1 =
| soundfile2 =
}}</pre>

The unnamed and named parameters define:
:1st= IPA symbol left
:2nd= IPA symbol right
:3rd= position offset from left side (in %)
:4th= position offset from top side (in %)
:soundfile1 = name of the left soundfile, when different from default (IPAsym-name).
:soundfile2 = name of the right soundfile, when different from default (IPAsym-name).

Subsequently subtemplate are called, calls {{tl|IPA vowels audio/soundbox}} and {{tl|IPA soundbox}}, to produce a soundbox + linked symbol per symbol.
